title: Team Autonomy Config v1
description: P0 of the team-autonomy design (docs/decisions/team-autonomy-design.md §10). Contracts and switches only: no behaviour reads these values yet, and every default reproduces today's behaviour. Unknown keys and out-of-range values are INVALID_CONFIG (contracts/autonomy.mjs).

autonomy.description: off = the product as it is today (current behaviour). on = the autonomy packages (P1-P6) are enabled.

strict.description: false = the F2 status: the chain root is the first accepted delivery's base. The design's target state (true) is a later milestone, not the default.

legacy.description: The one migration stance the design adopts (§5.2.4, §12 U5); the rejected stance has no implementation and therefore no value.

stopGraceMs.description: Grace period before the hard kill of a process tree (§7.2.3).

stopProofTimeoutMs.description: Second budget: how long the stop proof may take after the hard kill before the stop counts as unverified (§7.2.3).

decisionTtlMs.description: How long a decision row stays open before it expires (§12 U8: 15 minutes by default, configurable). Expiry never means approval.

unknownUsage.description: §12 U2: an unmeasured token count does not halt the team; it is recorded as unknown and escalated after unknownGraceMs.

unknownGraceMs.description: How long usage may stay unmeasured before a budget-unknown decision row is opened (§8.2.3).

pricing.description: Optional, display only (§8.2.4): no reducer reads a price. Without it the projection carries no cost field.
